items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I took Buddy Tate and Earl Warren, Dickie Wells and Emmett Berry, Herbie Lovelle, Al Williams and who else?

ctx.x: Yes, it sure is. Then while I was in Belgium I got a call from Jack Higgins. (LAUGHTER). To ask if I would like to come to England and play with Humphrey Lyttleton. Yes, that was one of the main things I wanted to do because I had heard a lot about Humphrey. Even Louis used to tell me about Humphrey. Jimmy Rushing used to tell me about Humphrey.

So I told him yes, I'd love to. So the next year I went over there with my own band. I didn't join Humphrey right away. The next year I took, before George Weir, I took Buddy Tate and Earl Warren, Dickie Wells and Emmett Berry, Herbie Lovelle, Al Williams and who else? And Rush!
